# City Paris

> > Comprehensive guide to Paris tourism featuring iconic landmarks, historical monuments, neighborhood guides, and travel itineraries for visitors exploring the French capital.

City Paris provides detailed tourist information about Paris's most famous attractions including the Eiffel Tower, Louvre Museum, Arc de Triomphe, and Palace of Versailles, along with practical travel guides, itineraries, and neighborhood explorations to help visitors plan their trips to Paris.

## Key Topics

- Paris tourism and travel guides
- Eiffel Tower (Tour Eiffel)
- Louvre Museum (Musée du Louvre)
- Arc de Triomphe and Champs-Élysées
- Palace of Versailles (Palais de Versailles)
- Notre-Dame Cathedral
- Montmartre and Sacré-Cœur
- Historic neighborhoods (Marais, Latin Quarter, Saint-Germain-des-Prés)
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Paris monuments and attractions
- Day trip itineraries
- French history and culture
- Visitor information and ticket prices
- Paris nature and outdoor spaces
- Canal Saint-Martin
